details:

tasks.name: Schema Validation Tests
tasks.details:
Create test/schema-validation.test.ts with ~25 tests

Categories:
- Valid commands (12 tests): All 6 commands + both naming styles
- Invalid commands (13 tests): Wrong types, missing fields, invalid values

Test all edge cases from PR review

sub_tasks.name: Valid command tests
sub_tasks.details:
Test all 6 command types accept valid input:
- view (with/without view_range)
- create
- str_replace (both old_str/new_str AND old_string/new_string)
- insert (number and string insert_line)
- delete
- rename

sub_tasks.name: Invalid command tests
sub_tasks.details:
Test schema rejects invalid input:
- Invalid command name
- Missing required fields (path)
- Wrong field types (path as number)
- Invalid view_range (not tuple, non-numeric)
- Invalid insert_line format

sub_tasks.name: Verify schema tests pass
sub_tasks.details:
Run npm test and verify:

- No regressions in existing 85 tests
- Test count increases as expected

tasks.name: Command Executor Tests
tasks.details:
Create test/command-executor.test.ts with ~30 tests

Categories:
- insert_line normalization (8 tests)
- str_replace naming flexibility (6 tests) 
- Command dispatch (6 tests)
- Error handling (8 tests)
- Fail-fast validation (2 tests)

sub_tasks.name: insert_line normalization tests
sub_tasks.details:
Test all insert_line type handling:
- Accept number: 5
- Accept numeric string: "5"
- Reject non-numeric: "abc" → clear error
- Reject float: "2.5" → clear error
- Reject negative: "-1" → clear error
- Accept with whitespace: " 5 "
- Large numbers
- Zero edge case

sub_tasks.name: str_replace naming tests
sub_tasks.details:
Test parameter flexibility:
- Accept old_str/new_str only
- Accept old_string/new_string only
- Accept mixed: old_str + new_string
- Accept mixed: old_string + new_str
- Fail fast when BOTH old_str AND old_string provided
- Fail fast when BOTH new_str AND new_string provided

sub_tasks.name: Command dispatch tests
sub_tasks.details:
Verify executor dispatches correctly:
- Each of 6 commands calls correct operation
- Parameters passed through correctly
- Context passed to operations
- Return values propagated

sub_tasks.name: Error handling tests
sub_tasks.details:
Test error scenarios produce clear messages:
- Invalid insert_line → helpful error
- Missing required str_replace fields → clear message
- File not found propagates
- Path validation errors propagate
- Errors include command context

sub_tasks.name: Verify executor tests pass
sub_tasks.details:
Run npm test and verify:
- All new executor tests pass
- No regressions
- Test count ~115 (85 + 25 schema + ~30 executor)
